summary: Verified 6.5/10 (the reviewer scored 6.5; the closing2 verdict of 2026-11-07 was 6.5; the first closing was 6.0). NOT ON PAR because the score is under 7.5. No blocker is confirmed. I checked that nothing has changed. There is no working-tree diff under art/out/fighters/sukri. No commit after 89112e613 (the GF-1 revert) touches the Sukri GLBs. The cards date from Nov 4. So the Nov 7 15:08 captures are still valid evidence, and I made no new capture. Frame timing was not measured: load was 6.25 at verify time, above the limit of 3. I viewed these myself: closing_sukri_r2_match_game_x4.png (a smooth white egg-shaped hood with no hem or value break; the cup is a small pale prop hanging off to the left), closing_sukri_r2_sheet.png (facings 3-7 show only the hood dome), sukri_shadeprint_portrait.png (white bars on the ink torso read as ribs, under a pale smiling disc), and sukri_stillwater_splash.png (a neutral stand with the cup hanging from the crook, not the breath on the cup that sukri.md:186 calls for, posterized edges). The lineup JSON gives accentPct 0.01/0.00/0.01/0.02 and accentOk false. All three majors and all five minors stand. Sensitivity is clear. In every view the hood is a rounded dome, including the side close-up, which is tall but rounded and not pointed. The face disc is wooden or pale with warm eye inlays and a smile, so it is neither blank nor a horror read. The Shadeprint 'skeleton costume' read is a theme-clarity major, not the horror-mask blocker class: the face smiles and has eyes. No missed sensitivity blocker.

findings.title: At the game camera the hood is a plain cream egg and the cup hook is sub-read
findings.what: From the gameplay camera the hood is one smooth, bright cream dome with no hem, seam or value break. It hides the face from rear facings. The cup is a few pale-blue pixels at the edge of the silhouette.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_sukri_r2_match_game_x4.png; closing_sukri_r2_sheet.png row 1 facings 3-7; art/renders/lineup/fw_CW6_m_lineup.json accentPct max 0.02, accentOk false; _harness/_reports/closing_sukri_r2_hood_lstar.txt p50 70.6 p90 87.3
findings.gauge: LoL champions have designed value breaks on the top surface, and the signature prop reads at the overhead camera.
findings.fix: Add a darker rolled hem and a centre seam to the hood, plus nape folds baked into the albedo. Grade the hood from cream at the crown to sand at the hem. Make the cup brighter, with a lit rim, and hang it higher, so the accent reaches at least 0.2% from every facing.
findings.verifierNote: I viewed the shot and the sheet and re-read the lineup JSON. The GLBs are unchanged since 89112e613. A major is the right severity: the figure is identifiable (a round mass with a staff), but it lacks designed reads.

findings.title: Cards are posterized 3D renders, and the skin splashes do not show their staged moments
findings.what: The splashes and portraits are posterized renders composited on a painted plate, with cut-out edges and lighting that does not match the plate. The base pose hides the mouth. The Stillwater and Shadeprint splashes stand neutral and do not show their sukri.md stagings.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/sukri/splash.png, sukri_stillwater_splash.png (viewed: neutral stand, cup hanging), sukri_shadeprint_portrait.png; _design/fighters/sukri.md:185-186
findings.gauge: LoL splashes are painted illustrations, with a kit-telling pose and lighting that belongs to the scene.
findings.fix: Re-pose each skin to its sukri.md moment, then do a paint-over pass that removes the posterize edges and adds rim light from the plate's own light source.
findings.verifierNote: I viewed the Stillwater splash: neutral stand, posterized edges, and no breath-on-cup despite sukri.md:186. Confirmed.

findings.title: Shadeprint reads as a skeleton costume on its cards, and its violet signature is not visible at rest
findings.what: Free-floating white bars on the ink torso read as ribs, under a pale, low-saturation face disc. The violet shows only as a thin ring on the cup.
findings.gauge: LoL skins state their theme clearly, with no unintended second read.
findings.fix: Make the bars continuous printed wrap bands that follow the cloth spiral, with a darker upper rim. Warm the disc toward toned wood. Add a violet inner glaze to the cup.
findings.files: art/blender/fighters/sukri.py Shadeprint palette; sukri_shadeprint.glb and cards
findings.verifierNote: Viewed. This is not in the sensitivity blocker class: the face smiles and has eyes, so it is not a horror mask or a blank mannequin. It stays a major for theme clarity.

findings.title: attack2 and Mote Toss share nearly the same staff arc
findings.what: The clip sheet shows the same back-left staff swing in both rows.
findings.gauge: In LoL, each attack and spell has its own silhouette.
findings.fix: Make Mote Toss an underhand lob from the cup hand, with the staff planted.
findings.verifierNote: Kept. It was already confirmed on 11-07, and the clips have not changed.

findings.title: The run carries the crook across the face disc
findings.what: In the run loop the staff stays in front of the face.
findings.gauge: In LoL runs, the face and the signature prop stay clear.
findings.fix: Carry the staff low and diagonal across the hips.

findings.title: Hands are stiff mitten fists or claws
findings.what: In the cards the hands are blocky fists, and the open hand curls into a claw.
findings.gauge: In LoL close-ups, the hands carry gesture.
findings.fix: Add a relaxed half-open hand pose and a cupping pose.
findings.verifierNote: Viewed: the right hand in the Stillwater splash is a stiff claw.

findings.title: Death keeps the cup on the hook and ends as a hood ball
findings.what: The cup stays on the grounded staff, and the final pose is a hood lump.
findings.gauge: LoL deaths end on a legible pose, with the prop placed.
findings.fix: Let the cup roll to rest beside the body, with the face disc turned toward the camera.

findings.title: The leather elbow cuff reads as a dark knob from behind
findings.what: On the staff arm, a dark leather cap breaks the cream sleeve.
findings.gauge: On a LoL model, small accessories sit inside the value plan.
findings.fix: Lighten the cuff to a mid tan, or move it down onto a forearm bracer.
findings.verifierNote: Visible in the back views of the sheet. It stays a minor.
